newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Rugby union-Campese gets chance to regain test spot.
newsitem.headline: Rugby union-Campese gets chance to regain test spot.

text.p: World record try scorer David Campese was given another chance to regain his test spot when he was named on Sunday in the Australia team to play Irish side Connacht on Wednesday.
Campese, who last month against Italy played his 100th test, was dropped for last Saturday's test against Scotland. A disjointed Australia beat Scotland 29-19 in that match.
Australia coach Greg Smith was not entirely satisfied with that win and forecast possible changes in the lead-up to the Wallabies' next test, against Ireland at Lansdowne Road on November 23.
Flanker Brett Robinson was named as captain for the match against Connacht.

Australia - Stephen Larkham, Ben Tune, Alistair Murdoch, Richard Tombs, David Campese, Tim Wallace, George Gregan, Tim Gavin, Owen Finnegan, Brett Robinson (captain), Toutai Kefu, David Giffin, Andrew Heath, Marco Caputo, Cameron Blades.
